newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany hails Serbia decision, will stay vigilant.
newsitem.headline: Germany hails Serbia decision, will stay vigilant.

text.p: Germany on Wednesday welcomed the Serbian parliament's decision to reinstate opposition election victories and warned that Bonn would be keeping a close eye on how Belgrade implements the new law.

"The Belgrade parliament's law recognising the opposition victories in municipal elections is a further important step in implementing the will of the Serbian electorate," Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel said in a statement.

"The German government will be following closely the implementation of the municipal election results. This remains a touchstone for the government's readiness to implement further democratisation measures."

Kinkel said Tuesday's parliamentary decision could only be a stepping stone on the road to greater democracy. All elected representatives from the opposition must be able to take up their seats on local councils without delay, he said.
"The decision-making powers of these councils must not be curtailed, their work must not be hindered," Kinkel said.
